title: Electronegativity ordering
statement: Electronegativity order is the transitive preorder of complete pairwise endpoint recurrence for identical shared electron support; equal traces remain an exact equivalence class rather than receiving an arbitrary rank.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of carrier, support, comparison, orientation, tie, extension, record and extra-rule choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite pairwise comparison of two named atomic occurrences joined by one shared electron-labelled support, with the complete recurrence trace determining endpoint preference or an explicitly retained tie.

choices.name: one-shared-electron-support
choices.reason: The same shared support is compared at both endpoints.

choices.name: complete-endpoint-recurrence-comparison
choices.reason: All registered support visits are compared.

choices.name: signed-difference
choices.reason: A signed magnitude violates the proof domain.

choices.name: forced-strict-order
choices.reason: Equal complete traces cannot be ordered uniquely.

choices.name: trace-equivalence-class
choices.reason: Ties remain one exact affinity class.

choices.name: complete-comparison-trace
choices.reason: Every endpoint and support record remains auditable.

choices.name: free-scale-constant
choices.reason: A scale constant can tune any ordering.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Complete recurrence comparison supplies the relation.

induction_base: One pair of atoms and one shared support comparison supplies the first affinity relation.
induction_step: Appending a pairwise comparison preserves all earlier traces and extends only by transitive closure; identical traces remain tied.
exclusions: no electronegativity scale, oxidation-state table, electrode potential, external definition, measured value or V2 result may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no electron carrier may be created, copied, silently erased or assigned to two endpoints
no qualitative structural law is represented as a parameter-free prediction of a measured decimal scale
external target content remains inaccessible until the complete prediction is sealed

Every finite pairwise comparison of two named atomic occurrences joined by one shared electron-labelled support, with the complete recurrence trace determining endpoint preference or an explicitly retained tie.
operational_witnesses: the comparison retains two distinct atoms

target_rows.source_locator: official IUPAC source set anchored at E01990

falsification_condition: The claim fails if the authority record lacks atomic attraction for shared electrons or permits a scale value to replace the retained comparison relation, or if a changed row is accepted.
